title: 第1003章 置身事外第1002章 新秩序
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
否则要真是为了什么九州苍生，大可以跟朝廷一同联手，跟洞天福地谈判。
而不是说了这么多屁话之后，最终要面对洞天福地的，只有大周朝廷。
完全将自己置身于事外。
不过姬玄同也懒得拆穿血日剑主那漏洞百出的谎言。
既然他想装就让他装好了，现在维持表面的关系对谁都好。
最好多装一段时间。
想到此处，姬玄同没有在这个问题上纠缠，转而问出了第二个问题。
“那些拥有奇异能力的东西是怎么回事？现在九州各地都有它们的出现。”
“规则松动。”
血日剑主几乎没有任何思索，就给出了回答。
“洞天福地重新回归九州，两方天地融合，不仅产生了大量灵气，也让天地规则产生了松动。
这样一来就使得武者更加容易突破。
也随之诞生了一些因为天地规则松动，而具备特殊能力的东西。
随着洞天福地的逐渐回归，这种情况应该也会越发常见，习惯就好。”
血日剑主停顿了一下，补充道：
“你可以把它们理解为，承载了一部分天地规则的物品。
它们的能力千奇百怪，就是因为所承载的规则各不相同。”
承载了一部分规则？
姬玄同眼中精光一闪而过。
这个说法他之前倒是没想到过。

现在结合血日剑主说的这些信息来看，从逻辑上确实能够解释那些奇物的能力为何千奇百怪，防不胜防。
这同样也可以解释，那些奇物为何不用气血或者真气就可以使用。
因为哪怕是气血或者真气，说到底也不过是天地规则的一部分罢了。
姬玄同点了点头，将这个信息牢牢记在心中。
刚想要继续说些什么，血日剑主的声音就再次传来。
“当然，这些只是我们的猜测而已，毕竟这些东西的出现，确实有些超出我们的预料。”
姬玄同闻言，心中倒是稍微松了口气。
如果这些奇物的诞生源自于意外，超乎了所有人的预料。
那就代表所有人对他们的了解都是一知半解，尤其是还尚未回归九州的那些洞天福地。
以有心打无心，或许这些奇物将来会发挥意想不到的作用。
随即姬玄同问出了最后一个问题。
content_en:
Otherwise, if it was really for the sake of the people of Kyushu, they could join forces with the imperial court and negotiate with Dongtian Paradise.
Instead, after talking so much nonsense, the only one who will finally face the Cave Heaven Paradise is the Great Zhou Court.
Completely remove yourself from the situation.
However, Ji Xuantong was too lazy to expose the bloody sun sword master's lies that were full of loopholes.
Since he wants to pretend, let him pretend. It is better for everyone to maintain a superficial relationship now.
It's best to pretend for a while.
Thinking of this, Ji Xuantong did not dwell on this issue and asked the second question.
"What's going on with those things with strange abilities? They appear all over Kyushu now."
"The rules are loose."
The Blood Sun Sword Master gave the answer almost without any thought.
"Dongtian Paradise returned to Kyushu, and the two worlds merged, which not only produced a large amount of spiritual energy, but also loosened the rules of heaven and earth.
This makes it easier for warriors to break through.
Then some things with special abilities were born due to the loosening of the rules of heaven and earth.
With the gradual return of Cave Heaven Paradise, this situation should become more and more common, just get used to it. "
The Blood Sun Sword Master paused and added:
“You can understand them as items that carry part of the rules of heaven and earth.
Their abilities are all kinds of weird, just because they carry different rules. "
Carrying some rules?
Ji Xuantong's eyes flashed with light.
He had never thought of this statement before.
Now combined with the information mentioned by the Blood Sun Sword Master, it can indeed be logically explained why the abilities of those strange objects are so strange and difficult to guard against.
This can also explain why those strange objects can be used without using blood or true energy.
Because even if it is Qi, blood or true Qi, in the final analysis, it is just a part of the rules of heaven and earth.
Ji Xuantong nodded and kept this information in mind.
Just as he was about to continue saying something, the voice of the Bloody Sun Sword Master came again.
"Of course, these are just our guesses. After all, the appearance of these things is indeed beyond our expectations."
When Ji Xuantong heard this, he felt a little relieved.
If the birth of these strange objects comes from accidents, it exceeds everyone's expectations.
That means that everyone has only a partial understanding of them, especially those cave heavens and paradises that have not yet returned to Kyushu.
With intention and unintentionality, perhaps these strange objects will play unexpected roles in the future.
Then Ji Xuantong asked the last question.
